title: Too Busy To Work Out? Cancel Your Gym Membership
hook: If you're too busy to work out, cancel your gym membership.
body:
Listen, the workout isn't what's eating your time. The commute is. You pack a bag, drive, park, change, workout, and drive back.

At home, there's no commute. You roll out of bed and start.

Once working out every day is a habit, you can always join a gym later.
